name: Lodha Developers Ltd.
business_summary: Mumbai-headquartered residential developer (MMR ~70%+ of pre-sales, model estimate; Pune, Bengaluru, new NCR entry and London projects) plus industrial/logistics and digital parks around Palava. Q2 FY27 pre-sales Rs 5,037 cr (+10%), PAT Rs 1,013 cr (+28%); H1 PAT Rs 2,386 cr (+63%) and management expects to exceed full-year profit guidance (ET/Business Standard 2026-10-30). Nomura sees H2 pre-sales +25% to Rs 143 bn. TTM operating margin ~33%. Market cap Rs 1.17 lakh cr, P/E 26.9.

exposures.mechanism: MMR-heavy (Mumbai, Thane/Palava) plus Pune/Bengaluru, now NCR; ~85% of value is residential. +10% market volume -> pre-sales +10% (Rs 5,037 cr/qtr base) -> EBITDA +12% (operating margin 33% TTM, leverage) -> EV/MCap ~1.1 (net debt ~Rs 10k cr model estimate), persistence 0.5 => ~+6. Anarock: top-7 city sales +3% y/y Jul-Sep 2026.

evidence.note: Anarock via Economic Times 2026-09-28: Jul-Sep 2026 housing sales +3% y/y to just over 1 lakh units across top 7 cities

exposures.mechanism: +25 bp: premium-mid buyers' EMI +2% -> volumes -1.2% -> -1.0%; interest cost +25 bp on ~Rs 14k cr gross debt (interest Rs 717 cr TTM / ~8% cost implies ~Rs 9k cr) = ~Rs 25 cr (~0.6% of PAT, mostly capitalised) -> -0.4; multiple derating, beta 2.0-2.3 (pack) -> -2.1. Total ~ -3.5. Note: Lodha rose 4% on 2026-09-18 on 'rate hike bets' (Livemint), i.e. the market sometimes reads hikes as growth-positive.
